ProblemHypothesis

A ride is planned in tools that do not know each other.

Trails, group rides and the record of the ride live in different places.

  • 1

    Access is hard to trust

    Trail access sits in posts and pins with no evidence, expiry or moderation.

  • 2

    Group rides run on chat

    Chat groups and payment screenshots, with no roster or capacity.

  • 3

    Rides leave no record

    A good ride vanishes: no journal, no recap, no places reached.

Why nowHypothesis

The pieces finally fit on one phone.

Hypotheses from the product docs. Market sources are still to add.

  • Touring is a weekend habit

    Riders and clubs already organise multi-day rides, mostly on chat groups.

  • The phone does the work

    GPS, offline maps and background recording, with no extra hardware.

  • Trust is the open gap

    The one competitor reviewed shows no moderation story behind trail access.

  • A working build exists

    The product is built and testable, so the first store release is the Foundation phase, Nov to Jan.

09 / 10

These are hypotheses to back with sources and rider interviews. None is a measured market fact.
